PaymentService/Get.sync_payment: PaymentService/Get depends on a CHARGED card payment (no3ds_auto_capture_credit_card); TrueLayer only supports open_banking payments and the browser-redirect bank auth step cannot be driven by automated CI, so no completed transaction is available to sync.
PaymentService/Get.sync_upi_collect: TrueLayer does not support UPI payments.
PaymentService/Get.sync_upi_intent: TrueLayer does not support UPI payments.
PaymentService/Get.sync_upi_qr: TrueLayer does not support UPI payments.

PaymentService/Refund.refund_full_amount: TrueLayer open-banking payments land in AUTHENTICATION_PENDING after Authorize; completing bank authentication requires a browser redirect that automated CI cannot drive. No CHARGED payment is available to refund.

RefundService/Get.refund_sync: RefundService/Get depends on a completed refund, which first requires a CHARGED open-banking payment; automated CI cannot complete the bank-authentication redirect.

PaymentService/Void.void_authorized_payment: The Void suite's fixed dependency is no3ds_manual_capture_credit_card, which uses a Card payment method that TrueLayer does not support.
